name: PT Rukun Raharja Tbk
summary: PT Rukun Raharja Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, operates as an integrated energy provider in Indonesia. The company involved in the trading of natural gas and CNG; transportation of gas; maintenance and operations of gas infrastructure; gas compression services, water treatment services; and management of LPG terminal facilities. It also provides management and consultancy services, as well as engages in power generation, mining, trading, and construction activities. PT Rukun Raharja Tbk was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Jakarta Pusat, Indonesia.
